briefings.title: The Evolution of CPU Architecture in the AI Era: S3 E6

people.name: Mike Clark
people.role: SVP, Corporate Fellow and Chief Architect, AMD

briefings.tldr: AMD CTO Mark Papermaster and Chief Architect Mike Clark trace the six-generation evolution of the Zen CPU architecture—from its 2012 clean-sheet inception to powering modern agentic AI workloads—while detailing the engineering balance of per-core performance, core density, and x86 ecosystem collaboration.

briefings.title: Wētā FX on the Future of AI-Powered Storytelling: S3 E5
briefings.tldr: Wētā FX CTO Kimball Thurston and AMD CTO Mark Papermaster explore how AI, heterogeneous computing, and simulation are transforming visual effects for major blockbusters like Avatar 3 and Stranger Things.

briefings.title: Agentic AI and the Future of Software Development: S3 E4
briefings.tldr: Agentic AI is fundamentally transforming software development and organizational workflows, enabling exponential productivity gains, multi-agent orchestration, and autonomous execution.

briefings.title: AI Compute: Rebuilt for the Agentic Era | Mark Papermaster, AMD | RAISE Summit 2026
briefings.tldr: AMD is pivoting from a component manufacturer to a holistic systems provider to meet the demands of "Agentic AI," which requires a rebalanced 1:1 ratio of CPUs to GPUs and an open-source ecosystem to ensure enterprise sovereignty and efficiency.

briefings.title: AI at the Edge: S3 E2
briefings.tldr: Liquid AI is pioneering a new class of "Liquid Foundation Models" (LFMs) that are two orders of magnitude smaller than traditional cloud-based models, enabling high-performance, proactive AI agents to run entirely offline on edge devices like AI PCs.

briefings.title: GAEA Talks Live from HumanX - How AMD Plans to Win The AI Era with AMD CTO Mark Papermaster
briefings.tldr: AMD is pursuing a "democratization" strategy for the AI era by building an open ecosystem and modular hardware that spans from massive cloud clusters to local PCs, prioritizing security through confidential computing and energy efficiency to prevent a societal divide between "AI haves and have-nots."
